description: Shared GS2 language corpus fixtures (source plus captured C# and official toolchain bytecode) for the Preagonal GS2 toolchain test suites. Data-only package: the fixture tree is embedded as manifest resources and read through Preagonal.Scripting.Corpus.CorpusFixtures.
Bowire Schema Designer rail — a graph view of a discovered schema's type relationships. Adds the Schema Designer rail descriptor, its graph endpoint and its per-rail JS fragment to the workbench.

Bowire service scaffolding — turns an entity spec into a schema (OpenAPI 3 or proto3), a runnable C# server stub, a workbench collection and a smoke test, from checked-in templates. The AI assistant can write the spec from a sentence; without a model a deterministic parser does.
Broker-neutral messaging contracts: IMessagePublisher, IMessageConsumer and ReceivedMessage<T>. Reference a broker package such as Budoom.MessagingQueues.RabbitMq to get an implementation.
RabbitMQ implementation of Budoom.MessagingQueues on the official RabbitMQ.Client: startup-declared topology, confirmed persistent publishing, self-healing consumers and plugin-free delayed retry.
